description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'PermissionRequester' used for managing runtime permission requests in an Android application. It handles asking for permissions, showing rationales, and directing users to app settings if permissions are denied.

classes.name: PermissionRequester
classes.description: A class to request and manage Android app permissions, including showing rationales and directing users to settings.

methods.name: requestIfMissing
methods.description: Requests permissions if they are not already granted, with an optional timeout, and handles rationale and settings dialogs.

methods.name: showRationaleDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog explaining why permissions are needed, returns true if user agrees to proceed.

methods.name: showSettingsDialog
methods.description: Prompts the user to open app settings to manually enable permissions.

methods.name: buildRationaleMessage
methods.description: Generates a message for the rationale dialog, listing permissions.

methods.name: buildSettingsMessage
methods.description: Generates a message for the settings dialog, instructing user to enable permissions.

methods.name: permissionLabel
methods.description: Provides user-friendly labels for specific permissions.
